description.value: Onggi is a bright and energetic Korean eatery located in Burnaby serving an extensive menu of traditional Korean comfort food, from cold buckwheat noodles and seafood pancakes to bulgogi, galbi, and rich stews like Gamja Tang. The restaurant takes its name from the traditional earthenware pottery used to ferment Korean condiments such as gochujang and doenjang. Delivery is available for cyclists who want to order ahead, and the menu offers generous, calorie-dense dishes well suited to hungry riders.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at theonggi.ca is fully accessible and provides the authoritative address (#103 – 4501 North Rd, Burnaby, BC V3N 4R7), confirming the restaurant is open and operational. The phone number matches between OSM (+1-604-420-0277) and website ((604)420-0277). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, washrooms) are mentioned on the website; the website does explicitly offer delivery, confirming takeout/delivery service is available.
concerns: OSM community field is tagged 'North Vancouver' but the website address is #103 – 4501 North Rd, Burnaby, BC V3N 4R7 — this is in Burnaby (near the Burnaby/Coquitlam border on North Road), not North Vancouver. The OSM record should be re-tagged to the correct municipality.
OSM record has no street address populated (only addr:unit=103); the full address was sourced from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible Korean restaurant with a confirmed active website and consistent contact details. A solid meal stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: calorie-dense dishes well suited to hungry riders
